description: Search hotels on WizTrip (the same search as wiz-trip.com/hoteles). `destination` is a city name, an IATA code or a WizTrip destination id from find_destination. Returns hotels with stars, area, room, board, free cancellation and the WizTrip selling price of the whole stay in USD, each with `url`: its wiz-trip.com page, where the person books and pays. A price marked paquete_itinerario_wizzo includes the "Itinerario Wizzo" and is never the hotel alone.

board.description: RO room only, BB breakfast, HB half board, FB full board, AI all inclusive.

country_code.description: ISO-2 country, to disambiguate the city.

destination.description: City name, IATA code, or a G…/D… id from find_destination.
